mapper.update: UPDATE t_mp_month_require_stock mrs JOIN t_mdm_product_info mpi ON mrs.FACTORY_CODE = mpi.FACTORY_CODE AND mrs.PRODUCT_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_CODE AND IFNULL(mpi.IS_DELETE, 0) = 0 SET mrs.PRODUCT_DESC = mpi.PRODUCT_DESC, mrs.PRO_SIZE = mpi.PRO_SIZE, mrs.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE = mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_CODE, mrs.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME = mpi.PRODUCT_TYPE_NAME, mrs.SPECIFICATIONS = mpi.SPECIFICATIONS, mrs.PATTERN = mpi.PATTERN, mrs.BRAND = mpi.BRAND, mrs.HIERARCHY = mpi.HIERARCHY WHERE mrs.FACTORY_CODE = #{factoryCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND mrs.MONTH_PLAN_VERSION = #{monthPlanVersion,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
